note: This file is the single runtime release pointer. Docs, evals, workers and receipts must derive current versions from it. Do not hard-code a current Qalam/Bible version elsewhere.

art-of-writing-bible-evals.note: Eval pack version is independent of the Bible version. 1.3.0 validates Bible 2.0.0; do not rename the pack to 2.0.0.

loading.rule: Load router + Bible for every writing task. Then load EVERY overlay listed for the selected profile. 'Load only the needed overlay' forbids unrelated profiles; it does not authorize skipping Bible companions or listed profile overlays.

legacy_labels.1.4.0: Historical docs/router integration label from 2026-09-15. Not the current router (1.1.0) and not the current Bible (2.0.0). Do not treat 1.4.0 as current.
